source.version: Part 14 — Abiotic Disorders and Diagnostic Reasoning — Batch 01
source.publicationAuthorization: Project owner authorized continued website publication on 2026-08-29. Independent specialist approval remains a separate project-control field and is not implied by publication.
source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-261–265 were reconciled against the controlled Volume 14 manuscript, current Penn State Extension diagnostic workflow/pattern guidance, and direct controlled medical-cannabis nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium response evidence. Public wording treats symptoms, age/location, chlorosis, necrosis, and leaf-shape changes as evidence with competing causes rather than photo-key diagnoses or automatic product recommendations.
source.note: This batch opens controlled Volume 14 with the diagnostic reasoning and symptom-vocabulary foundation required before specific abiotic-disorder mechanisms.
